call_points.text: Demand remains resilient on the back of GST rate rationalization and fleet replacement cycles, despite localized diesel supply concerns.
Gross margins were sustained via a 1% price hike in January and value engineering savings, offsetting commodity inflation.
Net cash position strengthened to ₹5,899 crores at the end of FY26, up over ₹1,650 crores YoY.
FY27 capex is planned between ₹750 crores and ₹1,000 crores, focusing on new products and EV/alternative powertrain technologies.
